speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis A (likely superimposed on acute Hepatitis B given high-risk sexual history and drug use).

The combination of recent onset agitation, jaundice, elevated liver enzymes, and normal abdominal ultrasound in a patient with high-risk sexual behavior and substance use strongly suggests an acute viral hepatitis infection, possibly co-infected. Given the severity of agitation and altered mental status, this could indicate early hepatic encephalopathy or a severe metabolic disturbance requiring immediate isolation and management. We will proceed with Hepatitis A, B, and C serology, as well as a toxicology screen for cocaine and acetaminophen to rule out other causes.
